capabilities: rename new files from the first x characters of content
use the first H1 header as the filename
target renames by folder paths and glob patterns
exclude individual notes via frontmatter flag
bulk-rename all files in a target folder
extras: The README warns to back up before using 'Rename All files'; a demo section exists (content not shown); manual install instructions and a buy-me-a-coffee link are included.
motivation: The README says the plugin can save time and effort renaming many new notes, and to 'simplify your file naming workflow'.
problem: New Obsidian files get untitled default names, so users must rename each one manually when creating many notes.
summary: Auto-rename plugin that names new files after the first x characters of their content, with folder targeting, header detection, and a bulk rename command.
